messages.content: Which river runs through the city where the 1936 Olympics were held?
I should first find the host city of the 1936 Olympics.
search(1936 Olympics host) -> The 1936 Summer Olympics were held in Berlin.
Now I need the river that runs through Berlin.
search(river Berlin) -> The Spree flows through the centre of Berlin.
The Spree

What is the capital of the country that hosted the 2016 Olympics?
Let me look up the 2016 Olympic host country.
search(2016 Olympics) -> The 2016 Summer Olympics were held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
Rio de Janeiro is a city, so the answer must be its capital.
search(capital Rio de Janeiro) -> Rio de Janeiro is a city in Brazil.
Rio de Janeiro
